description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] based on entry element damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode] and [Crystal Force Mode: Matoya] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Matoya
description.text: Fire/Ice/Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire, Ice and Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode
